title: Motion & Facial Performance Factory
objective: Provide deterministic motion and facial-performance production preparation over completed PCA character/rig foundations while preserving canonical Character, animation/motion, facial-expression/presentation and ARI owner authority and keeping generated performance derivatives distinct from canonical Character mechanics, intent or narrative truth.

scope.purpose: Prepare local-first, provider-replaceable motion and facial-performance production projections over existing PCA-05 character/rig candidate assets without inventing Character mechanics, intent, emotion/narrative truth or bypassing ARI resource/provenance/rights authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative authorized PCA-05 character/rig and owner/ARI inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable motion and facial-performance derivative plans with stable provenance and fail-closed invalid owner/reference/rights/adapter states while preserving canonical Character, motion/presentation and ARI authority and remaining useful with optional external performance tools disabled.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-05 exact-tree publication. PCA-05 satisfies PCA-06's direct gate but unlocks no rotation; MCCS remains blocked by PCA-06, PCA-09, PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER, so PCA-06 is the lawful next PCA item.
PCA-06 is selected only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it.
PCA-01..05 remain completed foundations and must not be silently reimplemented or weakened.
Character, motion/animation, facial-expression/presentation and narrative owner domains retain canonical mechanics, intent and semantic truth; PCA-06 is production tooling only.

ARI retains resource identity, source/derivative lineage, bytes/reference state and rights/use authority; generated performance media remains candidate derivative output until owner-governed registration/acceptance.
Detailed PCA-06 motion/facial/retargeting/presentation/ARI owner seams are deferred to governed-start targeted loading rather than guessed at selection time.
PCA-07+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this selection.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start PCA-06. Do not implement PCA-06 while selected_not_started.
